behavior.speed_definition: head_speed at each event's decoder time bin

constant_frequency_baseline.definition: Inclusive rank p-value of each event's unit under the constant mark law q_c = n_c / N (session event shares), ignoring the state distribution.

region_size_and_broadening.uniform_mixture_definition: Replace the Continuous prediction P at every event by (1 - w) P + w U, U uniform over the valid position bins, and recompute HPD overlap; a diagnostic counterfactual on the same events, not a refitted decoder.
